description: Retrieve a pre-formatted context string for a user, ready to inject into an LLM system prompt. Ranked by Temporal Memory Scoring. Can be called without a query to get the most important recent memories. When a team is configured, includes team memories automatically.

include_team.description: Include team memories in context. Defaults to true when a team is configured.

q.description: Optional query to focus the context on a topic

team_id.description: Team ID to include team context from. Defaults to SMARA_TEAM_ID env var.

top_n.description: Number of top memories to include

name: get_user_context
title: Get User Context
